title: Minimal/sidebar header (zen preset, demo-salon) drops every nav item after the 3rd on tablet/desktop; menu button is hidden there, so About is unreachable
where: packages/storefront/src/shell/header.tsx:129-139 (variant minimal|sidebar: NavLinks items={nav.slice(0, 3)} + MobileNav whose trigger is md:hidden in mobile-nav.tsx:18)
steps: Open http://demo-salon.localhost:3000/ at 768px or 1440px wide; list header links. Compare with the mobile sheet at 390px.
expected: All 5 owner-configured nav items (บริการ, ทีมเทอราพิสต์, บรรยากาศ, เกี่ยวกับเรา, ติดต่อ) reachable on every width (either all inline or an overflow/“more” menu).
actual: At >=768px header shows only บริการ /services, ทีมเทอราพิสต์ /staff, บรรยากาศ /gallery; the เปิดเมนู button is display:none (md:hidden). เกี่ยวกับเรา (/about) is not linked anywhere on the page (footer has only บริการ/จองคิว/ติดต่อ/privacy/terms), ติดต่อ only via footer.
evidence: tooling/qa/bughunt/responsive_a11y-kbd2.ts + kbd3.ts output: "salon header (1440): [สบาย สบาย->/, บริการ->/services, ทีมเทอราพิสต์->/staff, บรรยากาศ->/gallery, บัญชีของฉัน->/account, จองคิว->/book]"; same list at 768; mobile nav items at 390: [บริการ, ทีมเทอราพิสต์, บรรยากาศ, เกี่ยวกับเรา->/about, ติดต่อ->/contact]; salon footer links contain no /about. Midnight preset uses the same minimal header.
suggestedFix: In the minimal/sidebar variant keep the MobileNav trigger visible at md+ when nav.length > 3 (pass a prop to drop md:hidden), or render the remaining items in a “เพิ่มเติม” dropdown.

title: Reveal animation never clears its Tailwind v4 start offset: every revealed block stays shifted 28px (motion enabled), image-text images stick out and the page scrolls sideways on phones
where: packages/ui/src/motion/reveal.tsx:27-35 + 66-74 (HIDDEN classes motion-safe:translate-x-7 / translate-y-7 set the CSS `translate` property; motion animates `transform`, so the class offset is never removed)
steps: Browser with prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference, 390x844. Open http://demo-corporate.localhost:3000/ (or /work), scroll through the page, then read getComputedStyle on any [class*=motion-safe:translate-] element and document.documentElement.scrollWidth.
expected: After the reveal, elements sit at their layout position (translate none) and the page is exactly 390px wide.
actual: Inline style becomes `opacity: 1; transform: none;` but computed `translate` stays `0px 28px` (direction up) or `28px` (direction left). The image-text image is at left=44 right=402 on a 390 viewport, documentElement.scrollWidth=402, so the page pans horizontally; on desktop every revealed heading/card is permanently 28px lower than laid out (and the animation travels 56px instead of 28px). With reduced motion the classes are inert, so the bug only hits the default (motion) audience.
evidence: tooling/qa/bughunt/responsive_a11y-reveal.ts output: 390 scrollWidth=402 [{cls:motion-safe:opacity-0.motion-safe:translate-x-7.lg:order-2, inlineStyle:"opacity: 1; transform: none;", translate:"28px", transform:"none", left:44, right:402}, …translate:"0px 28px"…]; 1440 run shows the same translate:"0px 28px" on all revealed blocks. Screenshot tooling/screenshots/bughunt-responsive_a11y-reveal-offset-390.png shows the image cut at the right edge and the page panned 12px. Crawl: demo-corporate / and /work at 390 no-preference sw=402.
suggestedFix: Animate the same property the class sets: either animate `translate`/use motion `initial` with x/y instead of CSS classes, or add `motion-safe:[translate:none]` via a data attribute once in view (e.g. set data-revealed and use data-[revealed]:translate-none data-[revealed]:opacity-100), or switch the HIDDEN classes to `[transform:translateY(28px)]` so motion’s inline transform overrides them.

title: Hero/page-header H1 (TextReveal) is permanently invisible for visitors without reduced-motion on every storefront
where: packages/ui/src/motion/text-reveal-client.tsx:26-35 (word span starts at CSS motion-safe:translate-y-[110%] opacity-0 inside an overflow-hidden wrapper; whileInView never fires because the span is fully clipped so IntersectionObserver reports no intersection). Used by packages/storefront/src/sections/hero.tsx:68 and packages/modules/commerce/src/components/page-header.tsx:57 (also apps/web (platform)/page.tsx:67)
steps: Chromium, prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference (the OS default). Open http://demo-cafe.localhost:3000/ at 390x844 (or any demo-* home at 1440, or demo-shop /products), wait 6 s, scroll a bit.
expected: The hero headline animates in and is readable, as it is with reduced motion.
actual: No inline animation style is ever applied; every word span keeps opacity:0 and translate:0px 110%, sitting below its overflow-hidden wrapper (0 of 9 words visible). The hero shows only the eyebrow, sub-text and buttons; the H1 area is blank. With reducedMotion=reduce 9/9 words are visible. Same on demo-shop, demo-cafe, demo-restaurant, demo-salon, demo-clinic, demo-corporate home and demo-shop /products page header.
evidence: tooling/qa/bughunt/responsive_a11y-textreveal.ts (1440, 2.5 s): every tenant {inline:null, translate:"0px 110%", opacity:"0", wrapBottom:334, wordTop:336, visiblePx:0}; responsive_a11y-textreveal2.ts (390, 6 s): no-preference {words:9, visibleWords:0} vs reduce {words:9, visibleWords:9}. Screenshots tooling/screenshots/bughunt-responsive_a11y-textreveal-shop.png and bughunt-responsive_a11y-textreveal-cafe-390-no-preference.png show the empty headline area.
suggestedFix: Observe the (unclipped) wrapper/heading instead of each clipped word: put whileInView on the Tag (or a motion parent with variants) and animate children via variants; and use transform-based start state (or motion initial) instead of the Tailwind v4 translate class so the end state clears it (see RA-02).

title: Floating LINE button and fixed bottom bars sit on top of the footer's last row at max scroll (terms/privacy links not clickable)
where: packages/storefront/src/shell/floating-chat.tsx:16 (fixed right-4 bottom-4 / md:right-6 md:bottom-6, footer reserves no space); the commerce product sticky buy bar (div.fixed.inset-x-0.bottom-0.z-40) and packages/modules/restaurant/src/components/cart-bar.tsx (fixed inset-x-0 bottom-0) overlay the footer the same way
steps: Scroll to the very bottom of any storefront page: demo-cafe / at 1440, demo-salon / at 1024 (all six tenants at 768/1024/1440); demo-shop /products/sofa-throw at 390; demo-restaurant /order at 390 after adding an item. Hit-test the centre of the footer legal links.
expected: Footer bottom row fully visible and clickable (footer/body gets bottom padding equal to the floating element height, or the FAB hides near the footer).
actual: elementFromPoint at the centre of the footer link 'เงื่อนไขการใช้บริการ' returns the LINE FAB (demo-cafe 1440: link rect [1231,828,89x16] -> FAB 'แชตผ่าน LINE'; demo-salon 1024 same). On demo-shop product page at 390 both legal links are under the sticky '฿1,890 ซื้อเลย / เพิ่มลงตะกร้า' bar; on demo-restaurant /order the cart bar covers the copyright/legal row. The crawl flagged the FAB-over-terms overlap on 179 page loads across all tenants at 768-1440.
evidence: tooling/qa/bughunt/responsive_a11y-fab.ts output (hit tests above); screenshots tooling/screenshots/bughunt-responsive_a11y-fab-demo-cafe-1440.png (terms link half under the green button), bughunt-responsive_a11y-fab-demo-shop-390.png, bughunt-responsive_a11y-cartbar-390-bottom.png; responsive_a11y-crawl.jsonl coveredBottom entries.
suggestedFix: Add bottom padding to the footer (e.g. pb-24 when a floating chat/bottom bar is rendered, or a CSS var --bottom-ui-h set by whichever bar is mounted) so the last row can scroll clear of fixed UI.

title: Restaurant modifier sheet and cart sheet drop keyboard focus to <body> when closed (focus not returned to the menu item / cart bar)
where: packages/modules/restaurant/src/components/menu-browser.tsx:249-252 (ModifierSheet/CartSheet are controlled with open state and no SheetTrigger, so Radix has no trigger to restore focus to); modifier-sheet.tsx:29, cart-sheet.tsx:86
steps: 390x844, http://demo-restaurant.localhost:3000/order. Tab to an item card button (e.g. 'หมูสะเต๊ะสูตรคุณยาย (6 ไม้) ฿160'), press Enter, then press Escape. Also: add an item, activate the cart bar, press Escape.
expected: Focus returns to the item card (or cart bar) that opened the sheet, so a keyboard / screen-reader user keeps their place in the long menu.
actual: Focus trap and Esc work (0 of 20 Tabs left the sheet), but after closing document.activeElement is <body> for both sheets; the next Tab restarts from the top of the page (header) and the user must tab through the whole menu again for every item.
evidence: tooling/qa/bughunt/responsive_a11y-flows.ts output: 'focused card: button หมูสะเต๊ะสูตรคุณยาย (6 ไม้) ฿160' -> 'modifier sheet: {top:68,h:776,vh:844} focus: button ไข่ดาว+฿15 [in dialog]' -> 'tabs leaving modifier sheet: 0' -> 'after Esc: dialogs= 0 focus: BODY'; 'cart sheet focus: button ลบรายการ [in dialog]' -> 'after closing cart sheet with Esc, focus: BODY'.
suggestedFix: Remember the opener (document.activeElement) in openItem / when opening the cart and pass onCloseAutoFocus={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); opener?.focus(); }} to SheetContent (or wrap the card/cart bar in SheetTrigger).

title: Admin Settings > Team overflows the phone viewport (cards 388px wide in a 358px column, page scrolls sideways)
where: apps/admin/src/app/t/[slug]/settings/team/team-panel.tsx:74 (outer `grid gap-6` has an implicit auto column; card min-content is driven by the nowrap/truncate member line at :96-98 '{email} · เข้าร่วม {date}', so the column grows to 387.5px)
expected: Cards fit the 358px content width; long emails truncate with an ellipsis.
actual: document.scrollWidth = 404-405 at 390; every card on the page (สมาชิกทีม, เชิญสมาชิกใหม่, บทบาทและสิทธิ์) is 388px wide (L=16 R=404), the right border and padding are cut off and the page pans horizontally. The truncate classes never kick in because the grid column itself expands. Longer real-world emails make it wider.
evidence: tooling/qa/bughunt/responsive_a11y-admin.log: 'demo-shop 390 200 /t/demo-shop/settings/team OVERFLOW 405>390 offenders=9' and the same for demo-restaurant; responsive_a11y-admin-team.ts: ancestors 'div.grid.gap-6 w=358 display=grid cols=387.516px' > card 'w=388'; screenshot tooling/screenshots/bughunt-responsive_a11y-admin-team-390.png (cards cut at the right edge).
suggestedFix: Use `grid grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)] gap-6` (or add min-w-0 to the Card children) so truncate can shrink the member lines.

title: Checkout form a11y: order-note textarea has no label, and field error messages are not linked to their inputs
where: packages/modules/commerce/src/components/checkout-form.tsx:215 (
steps: Sign in on http://demo-shop.localhost:3000, add a product (POST /api/cart), open /checkout at 390 or 1440 and inspect the note field; submit with an invalid phone and inspect the phone input.
expected: Every form control has a programmatic label; error text is referenced by aria-describedby so screen readers announce it on focus.
actual: textarea[name=note] has no label/aria-label/aria-labelledby (placeholder 'เช่น ฝากไว้ที่ป้อมยาม, ห่อของขวัญ' only). Inputs get aria-invalid=true on error but nothing points to the '#<id>-error' paragraph, so the reason is not announced.
evidence: tooling/qa/bughunt/responsive_a11y-account.ts output for /checkout @390 and @1440: 'noLabel: textarea.flex.field-sizing-content.w-full.rounded-md type=textarea name=note placeholder=เช่น ฝากไว้ที่ป้อมยาม, ห่อของขวัญ'; grep shows no aria-describedby anywhere in checkout-form.tsx while Field writes id=`${id}-error`.
suggestedFix: Give the textarea id="note" and render the section heading as <Label htmlFor="note"> (or aria-labelledby the heading); add aria-describedby={errors.x ? 'x-error' : undefined} to each Input/select.

title: Shipped theme presets fail WCAG AA text contrast: primary buttons (aurora 3.31, porcelain 3.80, midnight 4.00), primary-coloured text (candy 2.55, aurora 3.11, porcelain 3.57) and muted text (candy 4.18-4.39, quartz/porcelain on muted 4.34/4.48)
where: packages/core/src/theme/presets.ts (aurora light primary #FF4D2E + fg #FFFFFF; porcelain primary #B76E79 / accent #7A9E7E with white fg; candy primary #F472B6 used as text-primary, muted #8A6E7C; quartz muted #64748B on #F1F5F9; midnight primary #9A7B2E; every preset's dark destructive #DC2626 on dark bg 3.5-4.1). resolve.ts:51-53 only warns, and checks muted against 3:1 (large) although muted is used for 12-16px body text.
steps: Run tooling/qa/bughunt/responsive_a11y-presets.ts (palette math) and the crawl contrast pass (responsive_a11y-crawl.ts, 1440px, computed colours of rendered text on solid backgrounds).
expected: Body text, button labels, badges and small primary-coloured text >= 4.5:1 (>= 3:1 only for >= 24px or >= 18.66px bold).
actual: Rendered examples: demo-shop primary buttons 'ช้อปคอลเลกชันใหม่', 'ไปชำระเงิน', 'สั่งซื้อและชำระเงิน', 'ขอรหัส OTP' white on rgb(255,77,46) = 3.31; prices '฿690' and eyebrows text-primary 3.11-3.31. demo-clinic 'จองเลย', 'นัดปรึกษาฟรี', 'ซื้อแพ็กเกจ', 'ขอรหัส OTP' white on rgb(183,110,121) = 3.80; staff titles text-primary 3.80; savings badges 'ประหยัด 26%' white on rgb(122,158,126) = 2.99. demo-cafe eyebrows/badges text-primary rgb(244,114,182) = 2.55; muted paragraphs, footer copyright and legal links 4.18-4.39; muted on muted 3.94. demo-corporate muted on muted 4.34. Dark palettes: destructive (form errors) 3.51-4.10 on every preset.
evidence: responsive_a11y-presets.ts output e.g. 'aurora light primaryFg/primary=3.31!(#FFFFFF/#FF4D2E) primary/bg=3.11!', 'porcelain light primaryFg/primary=3.80! ... accentFg/accent=2.99!', 'candy light primary/bg=2.55! muted/bg=4.39!', 'quartz light muted/muted=4.34!', 'midnight light primaryFg/primary=4.00!', dark destructive/bg 3.51-4.10 for all; resolveTheme warnings for demo-clinic: ['โหมดสว่าง: ข้อความบนปุ่มหลักอ่านยาก (คอนทราสต์ต่ำ)']; crawl contrast entries in tooling/qa/bughunt/responsive_a11y-crawl.jsonl (analyze with responsive_a11y-analyze.cjs <slug> contrast).
suggestedFix: Darken the light-mode primaries (aurora ~#D93A1C, porcelain ~#9A5562, midnight ~#7D6324) or switch their primaryForeground to near-black; add a separate darker 'primary text' token for text-primary on light backgrounds (candy/aurora/porcelain); bump candy muted to ~#755A68; use a lighter destructive (e.g. #F87171) in dark palettes; make completePalette test muted at 4.5:1 and block saving presets/overrides that fail.

title: Floating 'แชตผ่าน LINE' label is white 14px text on LINE green (2.26:1) on every page of every tenant
steps: Open any demo storefront page at 1440 (or 390) and measure the FAB label colour against its background.
actual: rgb(255,255,255) on rgb(6,199,85) = 2.26:1. Flagged on every page load of demo-shop, demo-cafe, demo-salon, demo-clinic, demo-restaurant and demo-corporate (e.g. 16 pages on demo-cafe, 15 on demo-clinic).
evidence: responsive_a11y-crawl.jsonl contrast entries: '2.26 need 4.5 fg=rgb(255, 255, 255) bg=rgb(6,199,85) fs=14 span.text-sm.font-semibold 'แชตผ่าน LINE''.
suggestedFix: Keep the LINE green for the icon/ring but use a darker green for the pill (LINE's own darker brand green #00B900 is still 2.6:1, so e.g. #05833A ≈ 4.9:1) or render the label in near-black (#0A0A0A on #06C755 ≈ 9:1).

title: Shell touch targets below 44px on phones: header account/cart icons 36x36, sheet close X 20x20, footer social icons 40x40, footer/legal links 16-23px tall, card CTAs 36px
where: packages/storefront/src/shell/header.tsx:53-66 (Button size="icon-sm" = size-9 for account + cart); packages/ui/src/components/sheet.tsx:47 (Close button is just the 20px svg, absolute top-4 right-4); packages/storefront/src/shell/footer.tsx:38 (social links size-10, text links with no vertical padding); packages/modules/booking/src/components/cards.tsx:87,125,176 use Button size="sm" (h-9) for 'จองเลย' / 'ซื้อแพ็กเกจ' / 'จองกับ…'
steps: Open each demo storefront at 390x844 (isMobile) and measure getBoundingClientRect of visible links/buttons (responsive_a11y-crawl.ts tap pass).
expected: Primary touch targets >= 44x44 CSS px (Apple HIG / WCAG 2.5.5), at minimum 24px with spacing (WCAG 2.2 2.5.8).
actual: On every page of every tenant: header 'บัญชีของฉัน' and 'ตะกร้าสินค้า' links 36x36; mobile-nav / restaurant sheet close button 'ปิด' 20x20 at top-right; footer Facebook/Instagram/LINE icons 40x40; footer menu links 18-23px tall and privacy/terms links 16px tall (e.g. 'นโยบายความเป็นส่วนตัว' 116x16, placed next to each other with a 20px gap); demo-clinic service/staff card buttons 'จองเลย' 73x36, 'ซื้อแพ็กเกจ' 94x36, 'จองกับพญ.ณิชา วรรณกุล' 200x36; commerce cart qty stepper 40x40 (product page stepper is 44); category breadcrumb/tab links 24px tall. (Booking-wizard specific targets are already covered by SBR-010.)
evidence: responsive_a11y-crawl.jsonl tap entries at 390, e.g. 'a.btn.inline-flex.items-center.justify-center 36x36 บัญชีของฉัน' on 54 page loads, 'a.flex.size-10.items-center.justify-center 40x40 Facebook' on 39, 'a.hover:text-foreground 119x16 นโยบายความเป็นส่วนตัว' on 28; responsive_a11y-flows.ts: 'tap: button.absolute.top-4.right-4.rounded-sm 20x20 ปิด' in the modifier sheet and cart sheet; responsive_a11y-account.ts cart: 'button ... 40x40 ลดจำนวน', 'input ... 48x40 จำนวน'.
suggestedFix: Use size="icon" (size-11) for header actions on mobile (md:size-9), give SheetClose a size-11 hit area (p-3 -m-3 or a Button size=icon), make footer links py-2/min-h-11 on mobile and social icons size-11, use size default (h-11) for card CTAs on phones, and size-11 for the cart stepper.
